scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.test:integration: export ES_URL="http://${ES_HOST:-localhost}:${ES_PORT:-9200}"; npm run _test:integration:cleanup; npm run _test:integration:start && npm run _test:integration:wait; status=$?; npm run _test:integration:stop; exit $status
scripts._test:integration:start: docker run -d --name flora-es-instance -e discovery.type=single-node -e xpack.security.enabled=false -e ingest.geoip.downloader.enabled=false -e ES_JAVA_OPTS="-Xms128m -Xmx128m" --mount type=tmpfs,destination=/usr/share/elasticsearch/data,tmpfs-size=128m -p ${ES_PORT:-9200}:9200 docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:${ES_VERSION:-7.17.28}
